Join us for the live broadcast of the headline match of the 8th round of the French Ligue 1, where the reigning champions and current league leaders, Paris Saint-Germain, will host one of their main challengers, Strasbourg, at their home stadium, the Parc des Princes. The encounter promises to be thrilling, as only one point separates the teams in the league table.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 17, 2025, 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

PSG comes into the match as the league leaders, having accumulated 16 points. Luis Enrique's side is in excellent form, especially in home games, where the Parisians have won their last 8 matches across all competitions. However, the capital club stumbled before the international break, drawing 1-1 with Lille, and will now be eager to return to winning ways. The team's lineup may not be optimal due to injuries to several key players.

Strasbourg has been one of the revelations of the season's start, sitting in third place in the table with 15 points. However, the team has struggled in matches against the league's top sides, dropping points late in games against Marseille and Monaco.

Head-to-Head History

The history of confrontations is overwhelmingly in PSG's favor. The Parisians have not lost to Strasbourg in 34 home matches in Ligue 1 (27 wins, 7 draws). In the last 16 meetings, PSG has claimed 10 victories to Strasbourg's 2, with 4 draws. Strasbourg's last six visits to the Parc des Princes have all ended in defeat.

PSG vs Strasbourg Prediction

Despite Strasbourg's excellent form, bookmakers and experts consider PSG the undisputed favorite. Their home-field advantage, historical dominance in head-to-head encounters, and superior player quality all favor the Parisians. However, Strasbourg is capable of putting up a fight and causing problems for the champions.

Real Oviedo vs Espanyol: Watch Live Stream Online - La Liga 17.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the ninth round of the Spanish La Liga, where Real Oviedo will host Catalan side Espanyol at their home ground, Estadio Carlos Tartiere. This match is crucial for both teams as they look to improve their league positions after recent disappointing results.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 17, 2025, 19:00 UTC (22:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Real Oviedo, who returned to the Spanish top flight for the first time since the 2000-01 season, are experiencing a difficult start. The team is in 17th place, just outside the relegation zone, with only 6 points from 8 matches (2 wins and 6 losses). Before the international break, Oviedo lost 2-0 at home to Levante, which led to a change in coach. Under the guidance of new manager Luis Carrión, the team will be aiming to end their losing streak.

Espanyol started the season strongly but have lost momentum in recent matches. The Catalans are winless in their last four games (two draws and two losses). In the last round, they were defeated 2-1 at home by Real Betis. Despite this slump, Espanyol sits in 9th place with 12 points and could move into the European qualification spots with a win. Manolo Gonzalez's side has also been struggling in away games, failing to secure a win on the road since April.

Head-to-Head History

The history between the sides includes 20 meetings, with Espanyol holding the advantage: 10 wins to Oviedo's 5, with 5 matches ending in a draw. In the last six encounters, Espanyol has won three times, Oviedo twice, and one match was a draw. Notably, Real Oviedo is unbeaten in seven of their last eight home games against Espanyol (4 wins, 3 draws).

Real Oviedo vs Espanyol Prediction

Experts anticipate a tight contest but give a slight edge to the visitors due to their superior squad quality. However, Real Oviedo will be highly motivated after the managerial change and with the support of their home fans. Considering Espanyol's struggles in away matches and Oviedo's historically strong home performances in this fixture, a draw appears to be a very likely outcome.

  • Likely Outcome: Draw. Both teams are not in their best form and will primarily aim to avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering that 5 of the last 6 head-to-head meetings have ended with under 2.5 goals, a low-scoring match can be expected.
  • Key Factor: Oviedo's motivation after a coaching change versus Espanyol's desire to end their winless streak.

Tune into the Real Oviedo vs Espanyol live stream on tutsport.net and follow the Spanish La Liga action!
